summary:
Eight 12x14 modules on the kit 1/2 grid: a blue double shotgun, a pink Creole cottage under one steep sweep of roof, an ochre hipped Foursquare, a plum and cream Queen Anne with a copper-capped corner tower, a blue-grey gable-front-and-wing, a dark board gambrel mule barn, an oven-and-tank yard with a green pavilion, and a brick two-storey company duplex.
Every roof and wall colour is new to the street. Each chimney is an exterior stack set into a wall (side stacks only where the wall is 3 in from the plot edge), with a mouth into a hearth, so every module cuts out cleanly. Eight-plot mill row with one house type per plot, two shared yards, and the architect's grid and masses untouched. The palette uses the plural ids (red_nether_bricks, nether_bricks, mud_bricks). Six parts: shell A, shell B, roofs, fittings, chimneys and ovens, grounds. About 42 rooms are boxed, with 3-4 beds per house and 3 per duplex unit; I did not render, build or run the toolkit's fit/walk checks.

concept_subject: A sunny row of eight plots along a gravel-and-dirt lane in a Mississippi cotton mill village, about 1900. Picket fences in different woods run along the front, each with a centred gate, and lantern posts stand every 12 blocks. Every house sits on brick or stone piers with a raised porch. From left to right: (0) a dusty-blue clapboard double shotgun with white trim and an oxblood tin front-gable roof. Its two doors sit side by side with tall shuttered windows, and gingerbread brackets carry a shared porch. A twin brick chimney rises at the back. (1) A pink-board Creole cottage. One steep dark cypress-shingle roof sweeps down over a full-width galerie on slim dark posts. Two pairs of French doors have green board shutters, and a brick chimney climbs the west gable. (2) A square two-storey ochre American Foursquare. It has a dark hipped roof with a front dormer, a white belt course and a full-width porch on brick-pedestal columns, plus a brick side chimney. (3) The superintendent's Queen Anne, the finest on the street. The ground storey is plum clapboard and the upper storey cream fishscale shingle. A front cross gable stands beside a three-stage square corner tower with a glazed belvedere and a tall copper pyramid cap. A wraparound porch has turned posts and a spindle frieze, and there is orange stained glass over the door. (4) A blue-grey gable-front-and-wing farmhouse with weathered cedar-brown roofs and a porch tucked in the angle of the L. (5) A dark vertical-board mule barn with a red gambrel roof and cupola, a hay loft door with a hoist beam, a wagon under a lean-to on the east and a small fenced paddock behind. (6) A gravel yard with an open green-tin picnic pavilion on six log posts over a long table, a domed brick bread oven with a smoking stack, and a wooden water tank on braced legs with rain barrels beneath. (7) A red-brick company duplex with stone sills and cornice, two front doors side by side, a two-storey porch on brick piers with a gallery above, a low grey hipped roof and two brick chimneys at the back.

parts.name: Shell A (plots 0-3)
parts.scope: Piers, decks, floors, walls, partitions, stair flights and the tower stages for plots 0-3, with every opening and reserved cell left as air. Uses pier_line, clapboard_wall, gable_infill, stair_run.

parts.name: Shell B (plots 4-7)
parts.scope: Shells for the plot 4 farmhouse and plot 7 duplex. Plot 5: barn crib walls, stalls, loft floor and ladder, lean-to posts. Plot 6: pavilion posts and plates, oven plinth and vault, water tank. Uses mule_stall, hay_stack, ladder_run, bread_oven, water_tank, cornice, stair_run.

parts.name: Roofs
parts.scope: A roof.json for every building with trusses and keep boxes for the stacks, plus the porch roofs, dormer, tower cap, lean-to, oven vault top and tank lid. Uses rafter_tails.

parts.name: Fittings
parts.scope: Windows, doors, French pairs, shutters, brackets, turned posts, porch rails, front steps, vents, fishscale shingle, signs, hoist beam and lanterns. Uses window, door_unit, french_pair, shutter, bracket, porch_run, turned_post, front_steps, fishscale, swing_seat, hanging_lantern.

parts.name: Chimneys, hearths and ovens
parts.scope: All house stacks and the oven stack through the roofs, hearth faces, stoves and the lit hidden-hay fires. Uses chimney_stack, hearth_face, stove, bread_oven.

parts.name: Grounds and yards
parts.scope: Lane, lamp posts, fence lines and gates, paths, the paddock with trough and composter, wagon, rain barrels, benches, garden beds and planting. Uses lane_strip, lamp_post, fence_run, garden_bed, wagon, rain_barrels, picnic_table.

recruit.why: Brick piers, foundations, the duplex's brick walls and cornice, and the oven plinth and vault
Clapboard and board-and-batten walls, the barn crib, the pavilion and tank frames, and the loft
Four stair flights that end flush with the upper floor, plus the barn and tower ladders
Eight roof forms: hip, cross gable, gambrel, cone cap and lean-to, with trusses
Windows, French pairs, shutters, porch brackets and rails, vents
Nine exterior stacks and the bread-oven stack with bottom fires and walled flues
The lane, fence lines, paddock and yards
Barrels, rain cistern, hay stacks and sacks
Light every room and porch to 8+ and the lane posts
